COLDWAR_KOR_record_presidential_term = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_install_elected_incumbent
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_constitutional_order
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_model = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Park Chung Hee" ruling_only = yes }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_presidential_term_served_park
					}
					AND = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Yun Po-sun" ruling_only = yes }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_presidential_term_served_yun
					}
					AND = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Kim Jong-pil" ruling_only = yes }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_presidential_term_served_kjp
					}
					AND = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Kim Young-sam" ruling_only = yes }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_presidential_term_served_ys
					}
					AND = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Kim Dae-jung" ruling_only = yes }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_presidential_term_served_dj
					}
					AND = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Chun Doo-hwan" ruling_only = yes }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_presidential_term_served_chun
					}
					AND = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Roh Tae-woo" ruling_only = yes }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_presidential_term_served_roh
					}
					AND = {
						NOT = {
							has_country_leader = { name = "Park Chung Hee" ruling_only = yes }
						}
						NOT = {
							has_country_leader = { name = "Yun Po-sun" ruling_only = yes }
						}
						NOT = {
							has_country_leader = { name = "Kim Jong-pil" ruling_only = yes }
						}
						NOT = {
							has_country_leader = { name = "Kim Young-sam" ruling_only = yes }
						}
						NOT = {
							has_country_leader = { name = "Kim Dae-jung" ruling_only = yes }
						}
						NOT = {
							has_country_leader = { name = "Chun Doo-hwan" ruling_only = yes }
						}
						NOT = {
							has_country_leader = { name = "Roh Tae-woo" ruling_only = yes }
						}
						check_variable = { current_term > 1 }
						check_variable = { ruling_party = COLDWAR_KOR_last_presidential_party }
					}
				}
			}
			hidden_effect = { kill_country_leader = yes update_set_politics = yes set_correct_ideology_trait = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_term_successor_active
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_term_successor_party = ruling_party }
		}
		else = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_term_successor_active }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_leader = { name = "Park Chung Hee" ruling_only = yes }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_presidential_term_served_park
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_leader = { name = "Yun Po-sun" ruling_only = yes }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_presidential_term_served_yun
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_leader = { name = "Kim Jong-pil" ruling_only = yes }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_presidential_term_served_kjp
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_leader = { name = "Kim Young-sam" ruling_only = yes }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_presidential_term_served_ys
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_leader = { name = "Kim Dae-jung" ruling_only = yes }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_presidential_term_served_dj
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_leader = { name = "Chun Doo-hwan" ruling_only = yes }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_presidential_term_served_chun
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_leader = { name = "Roh Tae-woo" ruling_only = yes }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_presidential_term_served_roh
		}
		set_variable = { current_term = 1 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_last_presidential_party = ruling_party }
	}
}
COLDWAR_KOR_on_native_election_campaign = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_constitutional_order
			has_elections = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_election_resolution_pending }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = coalition_forming }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_election_resolution_pending
	}
}
COLDWAR_KOR_on_native_election_resolved = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_constitutional_order
			has_elections = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_election_resolution_pending
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_install_elected_incumbent
			NOT = { has_country_flag = elections_in_progress }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = coalition_forming }
		}
		COLDWAR_KOR_1970_set_leader = yes
		COLDWAR_KOR_record_presidential_term = yes
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_lawful_election_completed
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_election_resolution_pending
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_djp_formed
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_electoral_party_22_legal
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_leader = { name = "Kim Young-sam" ruling_only = yes }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_ys_incumbent
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_dj_incumbent
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_ys_nominated
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_dj_nominated
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_leader = { name = "Kim Dae-jung" ruling_only = yes }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_dj_incumbent
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_ys_incumbent
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_ys_nominated
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_dj_nominated
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_ys_nominated
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_dj_nominated
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_roh_nominated
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_kjp_nominated
		COLDWAR_KOR_politics_sync = yes
	}
}
COLDWAR_KOR_calculate_charter_vote = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_support = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_electorate = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { party_banned_array^0 = 0 }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_electorate = party_pop_array^0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_charter_supporter_0 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_support = party_pop_array^0 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { party_banned_array^1 = 0 }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_electorate = party_pop_array^1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_charter_supporter_1 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_support = party_pop_array^1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { party_banned_array^2 = 0 }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_electorate = party_pop_array^2 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_charter_supporter_2 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_support = party_pop_array^2 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { party_banned_array^3 = 0 }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_electorate = party_pop_array^3 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_charter_supporter_3 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_support = party_pop_array^3 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_electoral_party_4_legal
			check_variable = { party_banned_array^4 = 0 }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_electorate = party_pop_array^4 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_charter_supporter_4 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_support = party_pop_array^4 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_civic_legal_5
			check_variable = { party_banned_array^5 = 0 }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_electorate = party_pop_array^5 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_charter_supporter_5 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_support = party_pop_array^5 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_civic_legal_19
			check_variable = { party_banned_array^19 = 0 }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_electorate = party_pop_array^19 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_charter_supporter_19 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_support = party_pop_array^19 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_electoral_party_22_legal
			check_variable = { party_banned_array^22 = 0 }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_electorate = party_pop_array^22 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_charter_supporter_22 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_support = party_pop_array^22 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_support_share = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_charter_electorate > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = {
			COLDWAR_KOR_charter_support_share = {
				value = COLDWAR_KOR_charter_support
				divide = COLDWAR_KOR_charter_electorate
				clamp = { min = 0 max = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_KOR_politics_sync = {
	COLDWAR_KOR_refresh_programmes = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_judicial_review
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_constitutional_order
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_court_appointments_implemented
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_court_implementation_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_court_commissioning_delay }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_court_event_queued }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_court_event_queued
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_transition.88 days = 1 }
	}
}
COLDWAR_KOR_politics_daily = {
	COLDWAR_KOR_politics_sync = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = KOR
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			date > 1970.11.12
			date < 1970.11.16
			has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_start_labour }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_labour_crisis_open }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_labour_crisis_open
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = KOR
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			date > 1971.4.26
			date < 1971.4.30
			has_country_leader = { name = "Park Chung Hee" ruling_only = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_1971_contest_pending }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_1971_contest_pending
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = KOR
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			date > 1979.8.10
			date < 1979.8.15
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_constitution_yushin
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_yh_case_open }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_yh_case_open
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = KOR
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			date > 1979.10.15
			date < 1979.10.20
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_constitution_yushin
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_buma_crisis_open }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_buma_crisis_open
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = KOR
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			date > 1980.5.16
			date < 1980.5.20
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_constitutional_order }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_officer_control_crisis }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_officer_control_crisis
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = KOR
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			date > 1985.2.11
			date < 1985.2.16
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_constitutional_order }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { party_pop_array^1 > 0 }
				check_variable = { party_pop_array^2 > 0 }
			}
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_opposition_reorganization_pending }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_opposition_reorganization_pending
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = KOR
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			date > 1987.1.13
			date < 1987.1.18
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_constitutional_order }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_torture_disclosure_crisis }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_torture_disclosure_crisis
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = KOR
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			date > 1987.6.9
			date < 1987.6.15
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_constitutional_order }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_opposition_constitutional_demand
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_constitutional_mobilization }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_constitutional_mobilization
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = KOR
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			date > 1987.6.30
			date < 1987.7.5
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_june_movement_1987_recorded
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_post_june_labor_wave }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_post_june_labor_wave
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = KOR
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			date > 1990.1.21
			check_variable = { party_pop_array^0 > 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_ndrp_formed }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_ndrp_formed
	}
}
COLDWAR_KOR_politics_maintenance = { COLDWAR_KOR_politics_sync = yes }
COLDWAR_KOR_politics_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = KOR
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_country_leader = { name = "Park Chung Hee" ruling_only = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_park_succession_unresolved }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_park_succession_unresolved
	}
	COLDWAR_KOR_politics_sync = yes
}
